title: Sector 0 built: the Stålheart prints for 75 s straight after the gate, its construction is defended from the seats and the gunship, and the first MÖRK rolls out of it at 124 s
context: Owner, 2026-09-24: "The opening should be just Isao coming out, and starting to build, diegetic, the problem there is that The Tank is built by the Stalheart... so the first few waves before the stalheart is ready could be more intense POV sentries and Gunship shooting from above to protect the construction of the stalheart. Then with the Stalheart we get the first tank, which unlocks the ability to explore on the ground and go get more resources/unlocks." And on the gunship: "its already in orbit, not equipped to develop a colony but its purpose is to defend new colonies." Spec section C (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-24-session-pacing-design.md): the Stålheart print begins about 40 s, stands about 120 s, the hull out by 150 s at the latest. Before (scripts/browser-test.mjs --grow at 64b65789, stage=1&grow=1): the hull was on the page from the first frame; Rotor 22.5 s, foundry beat 22.5-29.0, gate 29.0-37.0, tremor 37.8, breach 39.8, first fodder 40.3, landing pad 42.9, Stålheart print begins 42.9 (12 s, standing about 55 s, before the first wave was down), override 54.5, first kill 56.0, wave cleared 63.6, Quiver optic 64.7, handover 78.1, study 89.0, expedition 89.2; the gunship ran its own orbit (60 s away, 120 s on station) whatever the story was doing.
outcome: On a growing page (the bare page and stage=1&grow=1): (1) src/content/base-programme.js puts the Stålheart straight after the gate, due at rotor-ready, 75 s of print, with `hull: true` (the first hull comes out of it) and `readout: 'STÅLHEART'` (the HUD's objective row, src/fx/build-readout.js, refreshed per percent); the landing pad follows it. (2) src/domain/story-beats.js orders the Quiver the moment the gate stands (it was ordered at the override, which would have put it behind the 75 s print in Isao's FIFO), and gains a `construction` phase (STORY_PHASES, before `settled`, so the towers stay manual): after the Quiver's two hard cores the gunship arrives (storyApi.gunshipArrive: a free station pass and Isao's gunship_overhead line) and a wave from STORY_CONSTRUCTION rises from the sinkhole every 11 s, cycling soft waves and soft waves with a hard core, pace 1.5, harmless, held while 60 stand. It leaves for `settled` once the host says the Stålheart stands with its hull out AND the field is down to mopUp 0, then gives the new hull 8 s before Isao's study. A Stålheart already standing at the Quiver's clear goes straight to settled. (3) src/fx/hull-issue.js holds the hull until that step is printed: deployStart parks it unseen with playerDown (no drive, no fire, no touch damage), the frame does not draw it, the views strip hides and disables TANK (so 7 refuses). When it stands the hull stands under the gantry at a door berth (STORY_ROLLOUT: 4 m to 40 m from the plot centre along the rails, toward the gate) and, after a 1.6 s camera run to the deploy framing, drives out as any deploy; Isao says stalheart_stands. In the gunship's or SOL-82's seat it is set down outside the door instead (a gunner is never evicted). (4) The gunship's own orbit is held on a growing page until sector 0 calls it; after that free pass the call meter runs as after the handover (one gunshipOnCall predicate replaces the automated() test at the meter's five call sites). SKIP TUTORIAL, stage=N/story=N and a start past the handover are unchanged: hull at once, no construction. Isao's wave_cleared and quiver_cleared lines no longer promise a TANK button. After (--grow at 9046773e): Rotor 22.3, foundry beat 22.3-28.8, gate 28.9-36.9, tremor 37.7, breach 39.7, first fodder 40.1, Quiver stands 40.9, Stålheart print begins 44.7, override 54.3, first kill 55.7, wave cleared 63.9, Quiver optic 64.9, construction 78.4 (gunship on station), first construction wave 81.5, Stålheart stands and the hull rolls out 120.3 (3 waves, 73 bodies), hull out 124.1 with 68 of sector 0 on the field, sector 0 down and the handover 136.2, study 153.7, expedition 154.1, landing pad 154.1, solar 174.7, bays 195.7. src/td-tab.js is net zero lines (13 in-place edits). Integration follow-ups on branch pacing (2026-09-24): the handover also comes STORY_CONSTRUCTION.mopUpSeconds (20) after the hull is out whatever is left — --pacing stalled in construction for fifteen minutes because unmanned towers do not fire before the handover and the harness, like a player who drives off, did not ram the leftovers; and harmless fodder is now harmless to the gate, the heart and the sector's alive count as well as the tank, because sector 0's hundred leftovers broke the gate 4 s into sector 1 (--pacing --passive).
alternatives: Leaving construction the moment the Stålheart stands (the spec's first wording): built and measured, and it broke the rest of the run. The automatic towers fire without the seats' multipliers (1 against 60), so the 68-97 bodies left at the handover were still on the field three minutes later, every idle-gated print (the bays) waited on them and --grow timed out at the bays. The handover now waits for the field; the hull is out on time either way, and the leftovers are its first work.
Keeping the Quiver's order at the override: rejected, the order would sit behind the 75 s Stålheart print in Isao's queue and the Quiver beat would stall for most of it.

Starting the Stålheart print at 40 s by cutting the foundry beat or the gate print: not done; the foundry clip's 15 s to the first barrel is the floor, the Quiver's print is 4 s, and 44.7 s already puts the hull out at 124 s against the 150 s target.
Hiding the hull by moving it off the planet: rejected for the existing down state (playerDown), which every drive, fire, touch and pickup path already respects.

A dedicated follow shot while the hull drives: rejected, the deploy's own camera outranks a shot and already frames a hull rolling toward the lens; the shot is the run into that framing, the way the down dash leads into a respawn.
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --grow: before at 64b65789, after at 9046773e (green); it now asserts no hull and no TANK until the Stålheart stands, the STÅLHEART readout while it prints, the gunship on station over the construction, the hull drawn once out, and Isao's three new lines seen
